liveNote: Live figures — not final until the shift closes
liveBody: These are the figures right now. They change with every payment; the Z-report freezes them when the session closes.
noZTitle: No Z-report for this shift yet
noZBody: This session is closed but no Z-report was generated at close. Generate it now to freeze the figures — the report shows when it was generated.
noZNoPermission: This session is closed but has no Z-report. You do not have permission to generate one.
liveVsFrozenTitle: Live figures, not the frozen report
liveVsFrozenBody: These numbers are calculated now. The Z-report is the official record of the closed shift.
loadFailed: Failed to load the shift report
changeRoundingHint: Negative means more change was handed out than owed; the business absorbed the difference.
hashVerified: Integrity verified — the stored report matches its fingerprint
hashMismatch: WARNING — the stored report does not match its fingerprint
attribution: Cash by POS session in the drawer session
